answer.rationale: Use only a tightly bounded defensive pricing test for price-sensitive SMB accounts at immediate churn risk. The recovered source overrides memory_73’s positive generalization: the prior 40% discount lifted qualified revenue 18% but reduced 30-day retention 12%, so broad promotional pricing would conflict with the sustainable-revenue objective. The current retention-defense use case differs from the prior acquisition test and remains unproven; measure retained qualified revenue and renewal survival before expanding.
